rentalDebtService: Monthly debt service (principal and interest, excluding escrow) · USD
rentalTotalBasis: Total acquisition and improvement cost · USD
rentalAssumptions: NOI excludes debt service and capital reserves. Cash flow deducts both. Cash-on-cash uses entered equity; cap rate uses entered total cost. Enter taxes and insurance separately from debt service, without duplicating escrow. $0 means an omitted cost.
loanScheduleTitle: Loan draw schedule and interest method
loanDrawHelp: Blank: full loan funded at month zero. Enter actual draws within the committed loan limit. Points apply to the commitment. Monthly compounding assumes unpaid capitalized interest; the final partial month uses simple accrual. Confirm the contract.
loanLenderFees: Total lender, draw and inspection fees and penalties (USD)
hardMoneyAssumptions: Includes entered fees, points on committed principal and interest on each draw. Principal repayment is not a financing expense. Confirm accrual and capitalization with the lender.
arvAdjustmentsHelp: Enter dollar adjustments supported by condition, size, date or location evidence. Positive adds to a comparable; negative subtracts. Zero means no adjustment. The tool does not verify that a sale closed.
arvCompEvidence: Sale date, source and adjustment evidence
arvAdjustedRange: Adjusted comparable range (not a confidence interval)
arvAssumptions: Average of three prices plus user-entered adjustments. Sources and adjustments are not independently verified. The 70% rule is an initial screening heuristic; financing, holding and selling costs require the full deal model.
flipMathNotes: Earnest money credits the purchase price. Interest uses the selected draws and method; without a draw schedule the full commitment is funded at month zero. Net committed capital is not cash due at closing.
cookieMessage: We use cookies to improve your experience. Choose whether to allow analytics and marketing cookies.
rentAssumptions: Target yield is GROSS; annual expenses are only deducted from the displayed net income.
